root_causes.description: The frontend exhibits a severe latency regression: its user-facing server spans are pinned at 15-30s (p95_duration=30753ms) with zero errors, indicating requests are held open by a slow dependency rather than failing fast. CPU (0.118 cores), memory (~613MB) and restart count (0) are all nominal, ruling out resource or pod-fault causes.

evidence.observed_value: user_add_to_cart=30000ms; search_traces(frontend, error_only=True) returned 20 traces, 0 errors, p95_duration=30753ms
error_rate mean=0.000, max=0.000 across the window
evidence.expected_baseline: error_rate < 0.01; confirms latency (not error) fault mode

root_causes.description: Frontend browse and recommendation paths are both pinned near exactly 15000ms. Both frontend->product-catalog and recommendation->product-catalog share product-catalog as a common downstream dependency, so a slow product-catalog would explain simultaneous 15s stalls on both user_browse_product and user_get_recommendations. Not independently confirmed by a direct span fetch (tool budget exhausted).

evidence.observed_value: user_get_recommendations=15000ms and 51f3db064c6be894 user_browse_product=15001ms — both pinned at ~15s on the common product-catalog dependency

root_causes.description: recommendation sits on the frontend browse path (frontend->recommendation->product-catalog) and its user-facing span (user_get_recommendations) is pinned at 15000ms. A latency fault injected at recommendation would propagate directly to the frontend. Not independently confirmed by a direct span fetch (tool budget exhausted).

evidence.observed_value: error_rate mean=0.000, max=0.000 (slow but not erroring)

remediation_steps: Fetch the full span tree for trace 47f64c4e715ec886 (user_add_to_cart, 30000ms) and 152a1e56af4acd8d (user_get_recommendations, 15000ms) to identify the exact child span contributing the 15000ms stall and its owning service.
Compare per-service p99 server latency for frontend's downstreams (recommendation, product-catalog, cart, shipping, currency, payment, ad) to isolate the single slow dependency.
Review and tighten frontend request/upstream timeouts so a slow downstream cannot pin user requests at 15-30s; add circuit-breaking/deadline propagation.
Check frontend and candidate downstream pods for CPU throttling/resource limits and inter-node network latency.
Investigate k8s events on the quote/shipping path ('Killing: Container quote definition changed, will be restarted' and pause-image ImagePullBackOff) to confirm whether they impact checkout latency.
